prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1389; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover cracked across the center with the lower valance torn away, and the left tail lamp assembly broken. The trunk lid shows a crease at the lower edge and the rear panel has a buckled area consistent with a straight-on rear impact, which matches the impact as described. Repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp, repairing the trunk lid, refinishing the rear panel, and checking the parking sensor wiring. The labor hours submitted fit the extent of the damage. The invoices show no repeated charges. No earlier damage to this vehicle is known to us, and the photos show no older rust or filler in the affected areas.
